summary.en: Conan, Haibara, the Detective Boys and the married couple Akari Haga and Akito Haga are fixing the traditional house when Akari notices the strange stains at the wall near her husband, so he decides to touch it with his trowel, breaking it easily for some reason. This catches the attention of the kids as the Detective Boys assume there must be a treasure inside the wall. However, to everyone’s horror, the content inside the wall is the corpse of a woman. While the police are investigating, Conan notices that the corpse was wearing pajamas before she died, so he and his friends begin asking the couple about the house but it yields no result since nothing much about the former owner is revealed. Location: Kominka in Beika City Victim: Unknown woman Time: Between eight years ago and some months ago Cause of death: Unknown The investigation on the current owners of the house yields no result, so the kids switch the target to the former owner(s). The police are one step ahead, as they are able to find the person and confirm he is the culprit. The boys begin asking others about the former owner, and it seems that the police are one step ahead when they are able to confirm he is the one who killed the woman. After that, the Detective Boys visit the family again and enjoy the cake Akari treats them before waving goodbye to her and Akito, who happens to go back after buying material. On their way home, they meet Conan and Haibara again, who have been suspecting something is off about the husband, and decide to go back to the traditional house as Conan says that he will reveal everything once they arrive.
